title: Angle at the centre is twice the angle at the circumference
caption: The arc AC makes an angle of 140° at the centre O and half of that, 70°, at B on the major arc.
alt: A circle with centre O and points A, B, C on it; angle AOC is 140 degrees and angle ABC is 70 degrees.
description: A, B and C lie on a circle with centre O, and angle AOC = 140°.
B is on the major arc, opposite the 140° angle.
The angle at the circumference is half the angle at the centre: ABC = 140 ÷ 2 = 70°.

checks.name: A, B and C are on the circle
